map.垃圾分类回收率 使用指南: Waste Sorting Recovery Rate User Guide
map.输入垃圾总量与回收量，计算分类回收率与剩余填埋量，用于评估垃圾分类成效与减量目标: Enter the total waste and the recovered amount to compute the sorting recovery rate and the remaining landfill amount, which assesses sorting effectiveness and progress against reduction targets.
map.回收率 = 回收量 / 总量 × 100%: Recovery rate = recovered amount / total amount × 100%
map.成效评估：录入回收与产生量，求回收率并对比目标。: Effectiveness evaluation: enter the recovered and generated amounts to get the recovery rate and compare it with the target.
map.组分分析：对各类（纸/塑/金/厨余）分别求率，定位短板。: Component analysis: compute the rate for each category (paper / plastic / metal / kitchen waste) separately to locate the weak link.
map.教学演示：演示回收率与末端减量关系。: Teaching demo: show the relation between the recovery rate and end-of-pipe reduction.
map.：示例：月产生 100 t、回收 35 t，回收率=35%；厨余单列可达更高。: Example: 100 t generated and 35 t recovered gives a recovery rate of 35%; kitchen waste alone can reach higher.
map.回收率上限？: What is the ceiling on the recovery rate?
map.受组分与纯度限制，理论可回收比例外还有不可回收部分，目标设定需现实。结果按公开标: It is limited by the components and purity; beyond the theoretically recyclable fraction there is a non-recyclable part, so targets have to be realistic. The results are estimated from public standards and environmental factors, for education, teaching and emission reduction estimation; for formal accounting rely on official guidance (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial emission factors) and measured data.
map.和利用率区别？: What is the difference from utilisation?
map.回收率是分出比例，利用率是真正再生利用比例，后者更反映实效。结果按公开标准与环境: The recovery rate is the fraction separated out, while the utilisation rate is the fraction genuinely reprocessed, and the latter reflects the real effect better. The results are estimated from public standards and environmental factors, for education, teaching and emission reduction estimation; for formal accounting rely on official guidance (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial emission factors) and measured data.
map.前端精准分类、低值品兜底回收与末端提质，缺一不可。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算，: Precise sorting at the front end, a fallback recycling route for low-value items and quality improvement at the end are all necessary. The results are estimated from public standards and environmental factors, for education, teaching and emission reduction estimation; for formal accounting rely on official guidance (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial emission factors) and measured data.
